senses.gloss: परि-√ कथ् P. -कथयति, to mention, call, name, Tattvas.
परि-कथा f. a religious tale or narrative, Divyāv.
परि-कन्दल mf(आ)n. teeming with, full of (comp.), Bhojapr.
परि-√ कम्प् Caus. -कम्पयति, to cause to tremble, shake, BhP.
परि-कम्प m. tremor, great fear or terror, L.
परि-कम्पिन् mfn. trembling violently, Uttarar.
परि-कर परि-कर्मन् &c. See परि-कृ, col. 3.
परि-कर mf(ई)n. who or what helps or assists, W.
परि-कर m. (ifc. f(आ). ) attendants, followers, entourage, retinue, train (sg. and pl.), MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-कर m. multitude, abundance, Bhartṛ.; Bālar.
a girth, zone, waist-band, (esp.) a girdle to keep up a garment (˚रम्-√ बन्ध्, or ˚रं-√ कृ, ‘to gird up one's loins, make preparations’, and so परि-कर = आरम्भ, L.), Hariv.; Kāv.; Rājat. &c.
(in dram.) covert or indirect intimation of coming events in a plot, the germ of the Bīja, Daśar.
(in rhet.) a partic. figure in which many significant epithets or adjectives are employed one after the other to give force to a statement, Kpr.; Sāh. &c.
परि-कर्कश mfn. very harsh, Jātakam.
परि-कर्त ˚तन &c. See परि-कृत्.
परि-कर्ष See परि-कृष्.
परि-कर्ष m. dragging about, MBh. (cf. g. निरुदकादि).
परि-√ 2. कल् P. -कालयति, to drive about, chase, persecute, MBh.; R.
परि-कालित mfn. persecuted, dogged, MBh.
परि-कलयितृ mfn. surrounding, encircling, Mcar. v, 10 (read ˚यिता).
परि-कलितिन् mfn. = ˚कलितं येन सः, g. इष्टादि.
परि-कल्कन n. deceit, cheating, Dhātup. (cf. कल्कन).
परि-कल्प ˚पन &c. See परि-कॢप्, p. 592, col. 1.
परि-कल्प m. illusion, Buddh.
w.r. for ˚कम्प.
परि-काङ्क्षित m. (√ काङ्क्ष्) a devotee, religious ascetic, L. (cf. पारिकाङ्क्षिन्).
परि-कातर mfn. very timid or cowardly, Jātakam.
परिकायन (?) m. pl. N. of a school, L.
परि-कासन n. (√ कास्) frequent coughing, ĀpGṛ.
परि-किरण -कीर्ण &c. See परि- √ 1. कॄ, p. 592.
परि-किरण n. scattering or strewing about, Kauś., Sch.
परि-√ कीर्त् P. -कीर्तयति, to proclaim on all sides, announce, relate, celebrate, praise, declare, call, name, GṛS.; Mn.; MBh. &c.
परि-कीर्तन n. proclaiming, announcing, talking of, boasting, naming, calling, Mn.; MBh. &c.
परि-कीर्तित mfn. proclaimed, announced, boasted of, said, called, ib.

परि-√ कुप् P. -कुप्यति, to become greatly moved or excited, to be in a rage, to be very angry, MBh. :
Caus. -कोपयति, to excite violently, to make very angry, ib.
परि-कुपित mfn. much excited, very angry, wrathful, ib.
परि-कोप m. violent anger, wrath, Pañc.
परि-कोपित mfn. (fr. Caus.) greatly excited, very angry, MBh.
परि-कूट m. N. of a serpent-demon, L.
a barrier or trench before the gate of a town, L.
पारि—कुट m. an attendant, servant, AitBr. (Sāy.)
परि-कूल n. (prob.) the land lying on a shore, Pāṇ. vi, 2, 82, Sch.

परि-√ 1. कृ P. -करोति &c. (cf. परि-ष्-कृ), to surround, MBh.;
to uphold, Divyāv.

परि-√ 1. कॄ P. -किरति, (ind.p. -कीर्य), to scatter or strew about, ŚBr.; KātyŚr.;
to throw upon, impose, deliver over to (loc.), Rāgh. xviii, 32.
परि-कर—श्लोक m., Alaṃkārav.
discrimination, judgement, L.
परि-कर—श्लोक m. versus auxiliaris, Alaṃkārav.
परि-कर—बन्ध m. the binding on of a girdle in order to begin any work, MW.
परि-कर—भूत mfn. being instrumental, Āryabh., Sch.
परि-कर—विजय m. N. of wk.
परि-करित mfn. accompanied by (instr.), Vcar.
परि-कर्तृ m. a priest who performs the marriage ceremony for a younger brother whose elder brother is not yet married, L.
परि-कर्मन् m. a servant, assistant, L.
परि-कर्मन् n. attendance, worship, adoration, BhP.
dressing, painting or perfuming the body (esp. after bathing), MBh.; Kālid.
cleansing, purification, Śiś.
preparation, Kathās. (cf. ˚कर)
arithmetical computation or operation, W.
परि-कर्˚म-कथा f. prayer (?), Divyāv.

परि-कर्˚माष्टक n. the 8 fundamental rules of arithmetic (viz. addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, finding the square, extracting the square root, finding the cube, extracting the cube root), Col.

परि-कर्मय Nom. P. ˚यति, to anoint, decorate, adorn, Gīt.;
to make ready, Divyāv.
परि-कर्˚मित mfn. arranged, prepared, put in order, Var.; Sarvad.
परि-कर्मिन् mfn. adorning, decorating, W.
परि-कर्मिन् m. an assistant, servant, slave, ŚrS.; Suśr.
परि-कृत mfn. surrounded, MBh.
परि-कृत्त mfn. cut round, clipped, cut off, ŚBr.
परि-क्रिया f. surrounding, inclosing, intrenching, L.
attending to, care of (comp.; cf. अग्नि-परिक्रिया)
exercise, practice, enjoyment (cf. राज्य-परिक्˚)
(in dram.) illusion to future action (= परिकर), Daśar.
परि-क्रिया See परि-कृ.

परि-√ 2. कृत् P. -कृन्तति, (ind.p. -कृत्य), to cut round, clip, cut off, AV.; R.;
to exclude from (abl.), Mn. iv, 219.
परि-√ 3. कृत् (only p. pres. Ā. -कृत्यमान), to wind round, AV.
परि-कर्तन mfn. cutting up or to pieces, MBh.
परि-कर्तन n. cutting, cutting off or out, a circular incision, Suśr.
= next, ib.
परि-कर्तिका f. sharp shooting pain (esp. in the rectum), Suśr.
परि-√ कृश् only Caus. -कर्शयति, to harass, afflict, BhP.
परि-कृश mfn. very thin, emaciate, wasted, Vop.
परि-कृश—त्व n. a slender size, Lalit.
परि-कर्षण n. id., ib.
a circle, Śulbas.
परि-कर्षित mfn. (fr. Caus.) dragged about, harassed, tortured, R.; BhP.
परि-कर्षिन् mfn. dragging away, carrying about (to different places), R.
परि-कृष्ट m. N. of a teacher, VāyuP.
परि-कीर्ण mfn. spread, diffused, scattered around, surrounded, crowded, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-कल्पन n. fixing, settling, contriving, making, inventing, providing, dividing, distributing
परि-कल्पना f. making, forming, assuming (see रूप-परिक्˚)
reckoning, calculation, Var.
परि-कल्पित mfn. settled, decided
fixed upon, chosen, wished for, expected, made, created, imagined, invented, contrived, arranged, distributed, divided (with खण्ड-शः, cut or broken in pieces), Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-कल्प्य mfn. to be settled &c.
to be calculated, Var.
परि-कॢप्त mfn. distributed, scattered, found here and there, MBh.
परि-केश m. g. निरुदकादि.
परि-√ क्रन्द् (only aor. Caus. -अचिक्रदत्), to cry or make a noise round about (acc.), RV.
परि-क्रम m. roaming about, circumambulating, walking through, pervading, MBh.; Pur.
transition, RPrāt. (v.l. परा-क्र्˚)
following the course of a river down from its source to its mouth and then on the other bank up to its source again, RTL. 348
succession, series, order, Lāṭy.; Kauś.; Mn. iii, 214 (read आवृत्-परिक्रमम्)
a remedy, medicine, Car.
परि-क्रम—सह m. ‘one who bears running about’, a goat, L.
परि-क्रमण n. walking or roaming about, ŚāṅkhBr.
परि-क्रान्त mfn. walked round, stepped upon, trod
परि-क्रान्त n. the place stepped upon, foot-steps, traces, R.
परि-क्रान्ति f. moving round, revolution, BhP.
परि-क्रामितक n. (fr. Caus.) walking about (only ˚केन ind., in stage-directions), Bālar.; Viddh.; Pracaṇḍ.
परि-क्रामितकेन ind.,, in stage-directions
परि-क्री m. N. of an Ekāha, ŚrS.
परि-क्रय m. giving up at the cost of (cf. प्राणपरिक्र्˚)
hire, wages, KātyŚr., Sch.
redemption, buying off, W.
a peace purchased with money, Kām.; Hit.
परि-क्रयण n. hiring, engaging, Pāṇ. i, 4, 44.
परि-क्रीत mfn. purchased, bought, hired, MBh. (applied to a son = रेतो-मूल्य-दानेन तस्याम् एव [i.e. भार्यायाम्] जनितः, Nīlak.)
परि-√ क्रीड् Ā. -क्रीडते (Pāṇ. i, 3, 21; but P. p. -क्रीडत् pf. -चिक्रीडुः, ŚBr.), to play about (Impv. Ā. -क्रीडस्व, Bhaṭṭ.)
परि-√ क्रुध् P. -क्रुध्यति, to fly into a rage, become enraged, R.
परि-√ क्रुश् P. -क्रोशति (cf. -चुक्रुशुर् ind.p. -क्रुश्य), to go about crying, to wail, lament, MBh.; R.
परि-क्रुष्ट mfn. lamented
परि-क्रुष्ट n. lamentation has been made by (instr.), R.
परि-क्रोश॑ m. ‘crier’, prob. N. of a demon, RV. i, 29, 7.
परि-√ क्लम् P. -क्लामति, ˚म्यति, to be tired out or exhausted, Kād.
परि-क्लान्त mfn. very tired, tired out, exhausted, MBh.
परि-क्लिन्न mfn. (√ क्लिद्) very wet, excessively moist or humid, R.
परि-क्लेद m. humidity, wetness, MBh.
परि-क्लेदिन् mfn. wetting or wet, Suśr.

परि-√ क्लिश् P. Ā. -क्लिश्यति, ˚ते (p. -क्लिश्यमान, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 55), to suffer, feel pain, be troubled or vexed, MBh.; R.;
 (only ind.p. -क्लिश्य) to pain, torment, vex, harass, R.
परि-क्लिश m. (?) vexation, trouble, W.
परि-क्लिष्ट mfn. much vexed or troubled, pained, harassed, afflicted, exhausted, MBh.; R. &c.
परि-क्लिष्ट n. = ˚क्लेश, L.
परि-क्लिष्टम् ind. with uneasiness or reluctance, unwillingly.
परि-क्लेश m. hardship, pain, trouble, fatigue, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-क्लेष्टृ m. a tormentor, torturer, MBh.
परि-क्वणन mfn. (√ क्वण्) loud-sounding, loud, Nir. vi, 1.
परि-√ क्वथ् P. -क्वथति, to become boiling hot, Bālar. v, 48/49.
परि-क्षत mfn. (√ क्षन्) wounded, hurt, injured, killed, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv.
परि-क्षत-व्रत mfn. one who has broken his vow, Bcar.
परि-क्षति f. wounding, injury, lesson, Śiś.
परि-क्षय See परि- √ 4. क्षि.
परि-क्षय m. disappearing, ceasing, dissolution, decay, destruction, loss, ruin, end, Mn.; MBh.; Kāv. &c.

परि-√ क्षर् P. -क्षरति (aor. -अक्षार्), to cause to flow round (in a stream), RV.;
to bestow by pouring forth in a stream, ib.
परि-√ 2. क्षल् P. -क्षालयति, (ind.p. -क्षाल्य), to wash out, rinse, wash off, ŚBr.
परि-क्षालन n. water for washing, KātyŚr.
परि-क्षव॑ m. (√ क्षु) frequent or ill-omened sneezing, AV.
परि-क्षा f. (√ क्षै) clay, mud, dirt, L.
परीक्षा f. inspection, investigation, examination, test, trial by ordeal of various kinds (see 2. दिव्य), Mn.; MBh. &c.
N. of wk.
परि-क्षाण mfn. charred or burnt to a cinder, AitBr.
परीक्षण n. (rarely ˚णा f.) trying, testing, experiment, investigation, Mn.; MBh. &c.
परि-क्षाम mfn. excessively emaciated, dried up, fallen away, Kād.; Rājat.

परि-√ 4. क्षि P. -क्षिणोति, to destroy, BhP. :
Pass. -क्षीयते, to waste away, decay, become exhausted, Hit.
परि-√ 2. क्षि P. -क्षेति, to dwell around (with acc.), AitBr. vi, 32.
परि-क्षि m. v.l. for next, VP.
पारि—क्षि (1) m. N. of a man, L.
परि-क्षीण mfn. vanished, disappeared, wasted, exhausted, diminished, ruined, lost, destroyed
(in law) insolvent, Mn.; Yājñ.; MBh. &c.
परि-क्षि॑त् mfn. dwelling or spreading around, surrounding, extending (as Agni, heaven and earth &c.), RV.; AV.; AitBr.
परि-क्षि॑त् m. N. of an ancient king (son of Abhimanyu and father of Janam-ejaya), MBh.; Hariv.
of a son of Kuru and father of another Jan˚, Hariv.
of a son of A-vikṣit and brother of Jan˚, MBh.
of a king of A-yodhyā, ib. (cf. परी-क्षित् under 1. परी, p. 605, col. 1).
परी—क्षित् m. (√ 2. क्षि) N. of a son of Abhi-manyu and father of Janam-ejaya, MBh. &c.
of a son of Kuru, Pur.
of a son of An-aśvan and father of Bhīma-sena, MBh.
of a king of A-yodhyā, ib. (cf. परि-क्षित्).
पारि—क्षित् (m.c.) and पारि—क्षित॑, m. (-क्षित्) patr. of Janam-ejaya, Br.; MBh.
पारीक्षित् m. = next, MBh. xii, 5596.
परि-क्षित w.r. for परि-चित, or -क्षित्.
परी—क्षित (ŚārṅgP.) and परी—क्षिति (Prab., Sch.), m. = prec.
परीक्षित mfn. carefully inspected, tried, examined, Mn.; MBh. &c.
पारि—क्षित् (m.c.) and पारि—क्षित॑, m. (-क्षित्) patr. of Janam-ejaya, Br.; MBh.
पारीक्षित mf(ई)n. relating to or treating of or derived from Parī-kṣit, Pur.
पारीक्षित m. patr. of Janam-ejaya, MBh.
N. of a sovereign to whom the BhP. is supposed to have been addressed and of his successor, W.
परि-क्षिप्त mfn. thrown, thrown about, scattered, surrounded, overspread, MBh.; R. &c.
left, abandoned, W.
परि-क्षेप m. throwing about, moving to and fro, Hariv.
surrounding, encircling, being (or that by which anything is) surrounded, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
circumference, extent, Car.
abandoning, leaving, W.
परि-क्षेपक mf(इका)n. hung with (ifc.), Kāraṇḍ. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 146).
पारि—क्षेपक (or पारि—क्षेपिक), m. or n. (√ क्षिप्) objection (?), Car.
परि-क्षेपिन् mfn. who or what scatters or distributes, W. (cf. Pāṇ. iii, 2, 142).
परि-क्षीब or परि-क्षीव, mfn. drunk, quite intoxicated, W.
परि-क्षीब or परि-क्षीव, mfn. drunk, quite intoxicated, W.
परी—क्षित (ŚārṅgP.) and परी—क्षिति (Prab., Sch.), m. = prec.

परीक्ष् (परि-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. परीक्षते (pr. p. परीक्षत्, MBh.; imp. पर्य्-ऐक्षत् [Sāy. -ऐच्छत्] ŚBr.),
to look round, inspect carefully, try, examine, find out, observe, perceive, ŚBr. &c. &c.:
Caus. परीक्षयति, to cause to examine or investigate, Mn.
परीक्षक mfn. trying, examining, W.
परीक्षक m. a prover, examiner, judge, Rājat.; Pañc.
परीक्षणीय mfn. to be tried or investigated (-त्व n.), Nyāyam., Sch.
to be submitted to ordeal, W.
परीक्षणीय—त्व n.
परीक्षा—क्षम mfn. standing the test, Sarvad.
परीक्षा—तत्त्व n. N. of wk.
परीक्षा—पद्धति f. N. of wk.
परी˚क्षार्थ mfn. wishing to try or test, Āpast.
परीक्षितव्य mfn. to be tried or tested or examined or proved, Var.; Prab.
परीक्षिन् See नाणक-प्˚.
परीक्ष्य mfn. = ˚क्षितव्य, MBh.; Var.
पारि—काङ्क्षक and पारि—काङ्क्ष्˚इन्, m. a contemplative Brāhman (in the fourth period of life), L.
पारि—काङ्क्षक and पारि—काङ्क्ष्˚इन्, m. a contemplative Brāhman (in the fourth period of life), L.
पारि—कार्मिक m. (-कर्मन्) one who takes charge of the lesser vessels or utensils, L.
पारि—क्षि˚ती॑य m. the brother of Pari-kṣit, ŚBr.; ŚāṅkhŚr., Sch.
पारि—क्षेपक (or पारि—क्षेपिक), m. or n. (√ क्षिप्) objection (?), Car.
